import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 2000;
    static final int[] dr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int n, T, startR, startC;
    static int[][] A = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] B = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] F = new int[12][12];
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] things = new ArrayList[12][12];
    static int leftCnt = 0, rightCnt = 0;

    static int[] pairU, pairV, distHK;

    static boolean bfsHK() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int u = 1; u <= leftCnt; ++u) {
            if (pairU[u] == 0) {
                distHK[u] = 0;
                q.add(u);
            } else {
                distHK[u] = INF;
            }
        }
        distHK[0] = INF;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (distHK[u] < distHK[0]) {
                for (int i = 0; i < e.get(u - 1).size(); ++i) {
                    int v = e.get(u - 1).get(i) + 1;
                    if (distHK[pairV[v]] == INF) {
                        distHK[pairV[v]] = distHK[u] + 1;
                        q.add(pairV[v]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return distHK[0] != INF;
    }

    static boolean dfsHK(int u) {
        if (u == 0) return true;
        for (int i = 0; i < e.get(u - 1).size(); ++i) {
            int v = e.get(u - 1).get(i) + 1;
            if (distHK[pairV[v]] == distHK[u] + 1) {
                if (dfsHK(pairV[v])) {
                    pairV[v] = u;
                    pairU[u] = v;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        distHK[u] = INF;
        return false;
    }

    static int hopcroftKarp() {
        pairU = new int[leftCnt + 1];
        pairV = new int[rightCnt + 1];
        distHK = new int[leftCnt + 1];
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsHK()) {
            for (int u = 1; u <= leftCnt; ++u) {
                if (pairU[u] == 0 && dfsHK(u)) ++ans;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void bfsFromStart(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) Arrays.fill(F[i], -1);
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        F[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c = qc.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k];
                int nc = c + dc[k];
                if (A[nr][nc] >= 0 && F[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    F[nr][nc] = F[r][c] + 1;
                    qr.add(nr);
                    qc.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addMonsterEdges(int sr, int sc, int cnt) {
        int[][] seen = new int[12][12];
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) Arrays.fill(seen[i], -1);
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.add(sr);
        qc.add(sc);
        seen[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c = qc.poll();
            int lim = Math.min(T, F[r][c]);
            if (seen[r][c] > lim) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < things[r][c].size(); ++i) {
                for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {
                    e.get(leftCnt + k).add(things[r][c].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (seen[r][c] == lim) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k];
                int nc = c + dc[k];
                if (A[nr][nc] >= 0 && seen[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    seen[nr][nc] = seen[r][c] + 1;
                    qr.add(nr);
                    qc.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
        leftCnt += cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(B[i], -1);
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j) things[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        // Read first grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') A[i][j] = ch - '0';
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    startR = i;
                    startC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsFromStart(startR, startC);

        // Consume the newline after first grid (C++ code does while(getchar()!='\n');)
        br.readLine();

        // Read second grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') B[i][j] = ch - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < B[i][j]; ++k) {
                    things[i][j].add(rightCnt++);
                }
            }
        }

        // Set unreachable cells to INF
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (F[i][j] < 0) F[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        // Initialize e with enough capacity (leftCnt will be increased later)
        // We'll add lists dynamically in addMonsterEdges
        // But we need to ensure e has enough size for all left nodes.
        // Since leftCnt is unknown, we can add lists as needed.
        // We'll start with an empty list and add when needed.
        // However, in addMonsterEdges we access e.get(leftCnt + k). So we need to ensure that index exists.
        // We'll pre-allocate a large number? But leftCnt max is sum of A[i][j] which is at most 10*10*9=900? Actually A[i][j] can be up to 9, n<=10, so max 900. But we'll allocate dynamically.
        // We'll create a list and add empty lists as needed.
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        // We'll add lists on demand in addMonsterEdges.

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] > 0) {
                    // Ensure e has enough capacity for leftCnt + A[i][j] - 1
                    while (e.size() < leftCnt + A[i][j]) {
                        e.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    }
                    addMonsterEdges(i, j, A[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(hopcroftKarp());
    }
}
